profile.name: Wavestone SA
profile.summary: Wavestone SA provides consulting services in France and internationally. The company offers tech driven solutions, such as artificial intelligence and data, cybersecurity, industry 5.0 and IoT, information technology strategy and CTO advisory, SAP consulting, software and application development and integration solutions; and transformation solutions, including business strategy and transformation, compliance and risk, customer experience and marketing, finance, and procurement, human resource, operating model design and operational agility, change management, program leadership and project management, sourcing and services optimization, supply chain, and sustainability. It serves automotive, banking, beauty and luxury, energy and utilities, government and international institutions, insurance, life sciences, manufacturing, retail, travel, transport and logistics, and wealth and asset management industries. In addition, it provides research and consulting services. The company was formerly known as Solucom SA and changed its name to Wavestone SA in July 2016. Wavestone SA was incorporated in 1990 and is headquartered in Paris, France.
profile.summary_fr: Wavestone SA fournit des services de conseil en France et à l’international. La société propose des solutions technologiques, telles que l'intelligence artificielle et les données, la cybersécurité, l'industrie 5.0 et l'IoT, la stratégie informatique et le conseil en CTO, le conseil SAP, les solutions de développement et d'intégration de logiciels et d'applications; et des solutions de transformation, y compris la stratégie commerciale et la transformation, la conformité et les risques, l'expérience client et le marketing, les finances et les achats, les ressources humaines, la conception et l'agilité. Il est au service des secteurs de l'automobile, de la banque, de la beauté et du luxe, de l'énergie et des services publics, des institutions gouvernementales et internationales, des assurances, des sciences de la vie, de la fabrication, de la vente au détail, des voyages, du transport et de la logistique, ainsi que de la gestion de patrimoine et d'actifs.
